text:
Leah (Marketing Ops): Sprint check  Jun 30 customer panel. Need final reg page, Zoom recording + SRT, short NPS survey in follow-up, and gated replay timeline locked by Wed. Key asks: two CTAs, company-size bucket, 11d open replay then gated, calendar add, and clip micro-highlights.
Marco (Growth): CTAs: primary 'Reserve spot' (always) and secondary 'Request pilot' (show when company_size == 500+). Mobile shows primary only.
Tasha (Design): Pushed hero + mobile variants to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/uniquepanel/hero. Added small countdown badge and microcopy 'open replay for 11 days'.
Leah (Marketing Ops): Form fields: first_name, email, company, company_size (<50 / 50-500 / 500+), role, gdpr_consent required. Hidden fields: source_detail=panel_jun30, campaign_channel. Keep form to 6 fields max.
Priya (Sales Ops): Routing: company_size==500+ -> ae-queue + slack alert to #ae-inbox; else -> sdr-queue. Add lead scoring: if company_size==500+ and role contains 'CTO' or 'Head' -> high_priority=true.
Sam (Events): Zoom plan: cloud recording + audio transcript ON. Enable 'Optimize for 3rd party captions' to produce SRT. SRT ingest -> srt://ingest.redwood.example:9055/panel30. Local host recording enabled as fallback.
ZoomBot: Meeting created https://zoom.us/j/4445556666 (ID: 444-555-6666). SRT smoke test scheduled Jun 28 09:00 PT.
Leah (Marketing Ops): Replay policy: day 0-11 public open replay URL. Day 12 -> gated (email to unlock) + downloadable VOD for gated users. Clips (0:30 highlights) remain public. Also add 1-click Google Calendar + ICS.
Marco (Growth): Post-event cadence: 0-24h send replay + 1-question NPS micro-survey (1-5) inline; 48h send top 3 clips; day 7 nurture; day 12 gated full VOD. For attendees flagged high_priority -> AE gets Slack DM with starter note.
Tasha (Design): Thumbnails: need 3 crops + speaker headshots. Also supply small NPS CTA graphic for follow-up email.
Sam (Events): I'll take clip extraction live and mark timestamps for chapters: 0:00 intro, 6:40 demo, 24:10 customer Q&A. We'll auto-generate 3 highlight clips post-event. Push raw + processed to s3://redwood-events/panel-2026/ and set retention: public folder -> 11 days -> gated folder.
Priya (Sales Ops): HubSpot mapping: lead_source, event_name, company_size_segment, source_detail, campaign_channel, gdpr_consent, high_priority. Attendance rule: joined > 6 minutes -> attended_live = true via Zoom webhook.
Leah (Marketing Ops): Dev notes: include hidden numeric company_employee_count (validate integer), add simple captcha, and persist gdpr_consent boolean to HS property. Add ab_test param for subject-line A/B.
Marco (Growth): Also capture utm params utm_source and utm_campaign: panel_jun30. Hidden field event_variant to allow promo segmentation.
Sam (Events): Infra confirmed for port 9055 from Zoom IP ranges. I'll run SRT end-to-end on Jun 28 and a dress rehearsal Jun 29 10:00 PT. ZoomBot: SRT test Jun 28 09:00 PT; dress rehearsal Jun 29 10:00 PT.
Tasha (Design): Deliver thumbnails + NPS asset by Jun 27 EOD.
Leah (Marketing Ops): Ownership recap: Leah=reg page + consent copy + exports; Tasha=hero + thumbnails + NPS graphic; Sam=Zoom + SRT + clips + S3; Marco=emails + HS routing + AB subject test; Priya=sales routing + AE brief.
Priya (Sales Ops): Quick ask: include sample AE starter: 'Attended panel; mentions latency and cost; follow up re: pilot.' Add to HS note template.
Leah (Marketing Ops): Will add note template. Please react with :white_check_mark: when tasks are done so I can close Asana ticket.

Tasha (Design): :white_check_mark:
